warwatch.label: HFGCS · 02:26 UTC · 29 SEP
warwatch.title: Coded radio message logged
warwatch.deck: War Watch Intel’s watch floor lists an Emergency Action Message preamble, 564UTJ, at 02:26 UTC.
warwatch.heading: What was heard
paragraphs: The watch floor records 564UTJ at 02:26 UTC on 29 September, credited to SailawayDebstaAU. It reports a 30-character message. The preceding 56RG2X header was logged three times on 28 September, from 20:49 to 22:10 UTC.

The coded content does not disclose the message’s purpose. For listeners, the useful next step is to compare the log with live reception and aircraft activity, without treating the code itself as proof of an operation.

skyglass.label: SKYGLASS · 29 SEP
skyglass.title: P-8 takes off near Nakagusuku
skyglass.deck: A P-8 maritime patrol aircraft was reported taking off near Nakagusuku, Japan.
skyglass.heading: P-8 departure near Nakagusuku
paragraphs: SkyGlass reported a U.S.-registered P-8 taking off near Nakagusuku. The P-8 is a maritime patrol aircraft used for surveillance, reconnaissance and anti-submarine work. A departure alert identifies movement; it does not establish the aircraft’s mission.
The alert identifies an aircraft type and location, but does not confirm its destination or tasking.
